description: Preview ranked best-fit talent for one of your OpenTrain WorkProjects (semantic match against the linked-job text blended with portable reputation). Each candidate carries its available commit action: INVITE (not yet hired), ASSIGN (already hired on the linked job), or ALREADY_ASSIGNED. Preview only — commit one candidate with opentrain_commit_talent_match. Requires talent:read scope.
name: opentrain_match_talent
